run_cifar10_experiment: run the xmanager launcher to train a CIFAR10 model on Vertex AI with configurable batch sizes and learning rates
create_experiment_cifar10: create an xmanager experiment titled cifar10 that packages and launches distributed training jobs
build_hyperparameter_trials: build a grid of hyperparameter trials combining batch sizes and learning rates for distributed training
launch_distributed_jobs: launch distributed training jobs across multiple nodes with configurable GPUs per node
package_python_container: package a python container with a specified base image and entrypoint for xmanager execution
